next.reason: 1985: "LABEL {RECORD IS|RECORDS ARE} {STANDARD|OMITTED} ... VALUE OF implementor-name-1 IS ... DATA {RECORD IS|RECORDS ARE}"; 2023: "FD file-name-1 [IS EXTERNAL [AS literal-1]] [IS GLOBAL] [BLOCK CONTAINS ...] [ record-clause ] .". The 2023 Format 2 FD keeps BLOCK CONTAINS and RECORD but drops the LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF and DATA RECORDS clauses, so 1985 entries using them are refused.
